exemplos.en: When you get to Lumbridge, look out for Adventurer Jon, he can be found outside of the Sheared Ram pub.

exemplos.en: The following quests and their pre-reqs are automatically completed but will not reward any completion XP: - Prince Ali Rescue - The Golem - Shadow of the Storm - Icthlarin's Little Helper - Temple of the Eye - Desert Treasure II The following tasks in the Desert Achievement Diary are automatically completed: Medium Tasks: - Travel to the Desert via the Eagle transport system Hard Tasks: - Slay a dust devil in the desert cave with a Slayer Helmet equipped - Refill your Waterskins in the Desert using Lunar spells Elite Tasks: - Bake a wild pie at the Nardah clay oven - Speak to the Kalphite Queen Head in your Player Owned House The above Kalphite Queen Head diary task will complete when you receive a Kalphite Queen Head or Kalphite Queen Head(tattered) drop instead. Near the Mage training arena entrance there will be a portal to Guardians of the rift. The following Combat Achievements are automatically completed: - Tomb Explorer - Tomb Raider - Tomb Looter - Novice Tomb Explorer - Novice Tomb Raider - Novice Tomb Looter - Expert Tomb Looter - Expert Tomb Raider - Insect Deflection
exemplos.pt: As quests a seguir e seus pré-requisitos são concluídos automaticamente, mas não dão XP de conclusão: Prince Ali Rescue, The Golem, Shadow of the Storm, Icthlarin's Little Helper, Temple of the Eye, Desert Treasure II. The following tasks no Desert Achievement Diary são concluídas automaticamente. Medium Tasks: viajar para o deserto pelo sistema de transporte Eagle. Hard Tasks: matar um dust devil na caverna do deserto com um Slayer Helmet equipado; reabastecer seus Waterskins no deserto usando spells Lunar. Elite Tasks: assar um wild pie no forno de argila de Nardah; falar com a Kalphite Queen Head no seu Player Owned House. Essa tarefa do diary da Kalphite Queen Head é concluída, em vez disso, ao receber um drop de Kalphite Queen Head ou Kalphite Queen Head(tattered). Near the Mage training arena entrance há um portal para Guardiões do Rift. The following Combat Achievements são concluídas automaticamente: Tomb Explorer, Tomb Raider, Tomb Looter, Novice Tomb Explorer, Novice Tomb Raider, Novice Tomb Looter, Expert Tomb Looter, Expert Tomb Raider, Insect Deflection
